verdict: No open implementation blockers for the reviewed submission/first-claim/recovery website component
scope: Read-only review of current dirty website sources and exact reviewed Truss b120e1de bundle. No source edits, no batch effects execution, no newly delivered execution bundle consumed.
conclusions: Original submission key and control request/attempt are distinct and retained atomically before first dispatch. Claim has its own original control. Only strict transaction completion permits dispatch.

Competing pages cannot reserve the same original slot twice; fresh journal reads and original input/context checks prevent stale tab replacement. Quota, aborted and non-strict transactions refuse before dispatch.
Submit, claim, recovery and review forward current original provider unions without narrowing fields. Complete control outcomes survive host journal serialization.
Actual lost initial submission/claim acknowledgements recover the exact originally sampled job, fence and lease. Current job review reports running, zero committed batches and unchanged manifest.

Independent interruptions after durable host admission and before native dispatch recover through the actual provider as unresolved/not_found. No same-key redispatch, new control fallback or claim mutation occurs; a missing claim leaves the actual job queued with zero committed batches.
Recovered claim data does not enable execution: no execute command/API is exposed by this website component. Private owner/action/read-grant capabilities remain in the worker.
Pinned source cohort and static assets remain intact; original compiler and provider builds reproduce current served bytes. The original native person cohort is not relabelled or substituted.

publicationGate.reason: Pinned read-only verify --all reports action-compiler.html STALE; 16 other claims VALID. Parent is awaiting human 1Password signing authorization. No signature key access or signing attempted by reviewer.

limitations: This is a component checkpoint, not completion of mutating end-to-end UPDATE, batch execution, cancellation, retirement/retention or full local bulk qualification.
No generic native human/service security equivalence, arbitrary model/SQL support, full crash/liveness guarantee or persistent browser-storage eviction guarantee is inferred.
The forthcoming execution bundle requires a separate review and original effect-admission/recovery integration; a recovered claim alone supplies no host first-dispatch eligibility.
harnessNotes: Two reviewer-only harness errors were corrected and retained in separate logs: using reason instead of the original unresolved carrier code field, and passing ArrayBuffer rather than Uint8Array to final SHA256 recording. No repository defect or source change was involved. Final independent run passed all seven behavior controls.
